# IrisGo Information

View Top Employees from IrisGo

IrisGo is an on-device AI assistant designed for AI PCs. It prioritizes privacy, with all operations and data processed locally, ensuring data never leaves your device. The key to IrisGo lies in its ability to understand your computer usage context, access and comprehend local files, and automate repetitive workflows through observing your actions ("tracking learning"). It also offers local LLM-based functionalities such as document summarization and local file querying. IrisGo primarily enters the market through pre-installation partnerships with major PC manufacturers, aiming to deliver a faster, more secure, and smarter AI experience that significantly enhances user efficiency. ## How to set up Plutio for your solopreneur business

Setting up Plutio takes 2-4 hours for initial configuration, and every new client after that benefits from the connected workflow.

### Step 1: Configure your brand (30 mins)

Upload your logo, set brand colors, and add your business details. Connect Stripe or PayPal for payments. If you are on the Max plan, connect your custom domain so clients experience your brand, not a third-party URL.

### Step 2: Build your core templates (1-2 hours)

Create proposal and project templates for your most common engagements. Start with 2-3 templates:

### Step 3: Connect integrations (20 mins) [...] ### Step 3: Set up integrations (30 mins)

Connect Stripe or PayPal for payments. Sync Google Calendar or Outlook for scheduling. Link QuickBooks or Xero for accounting if needed. Test each integration with a sample transaction.

### Step 4: Import client data (30 mins)

Upload your client CSV and map fields to Plutio's structure. Run a test batch of 5-10 clients first to verify everything imports correctly.

### Step 5: Use Plutio for new work only

Every new prospect goes through Plutio from day one. Active projects stay in the current tools until they complete. Running both systems for 2-4 weeks ensures nothing falls through the cracks during the switch.

### Step 6: Cancel old subscriptions [...] Yes. Plutio has iOS and Android apps for checking client status, responding to messages, reviewing invoices, and managing schedules on the go. Most solopreneurs use desktop for creating proposals and project setup, and mobile for quick updates and client communication.

### How does Plutio handle payment plans for solopreneurs?

When sending proposals, solopreneurs can offer multiple payment options: full payment upfront, split into installments (2, 3, or 6 payments), or milestone-based billing. Clients choose their preferred option at acceptance time. Payments process automatically on schedule.
